name: Keyrus S.A.
summary: Keyrus S.A. provides performance management consulting and technical solutions integration services worldwide. It offers management and transformation services, such as strategy and innovation, digital transformation, performance management, and project support service; and data intelligence services, including business intelligence, information management, big data analytics, enterprise performance management, and externalization and training services. The company also provides digital experience services comprising digital marketing and customer relationship management, digital commerce, and digital performance services, as well as innovation and digital strategy, and user experience solutions. It serves insurance, automobile, retail banking, energy and utilities, finance and investment, pharmaceutical, social welfare, retail, telecommunications, construction, culture, health, hotel and catering, luxury, media, public, real estate, industrial, services, and transport sectors. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Levallois-Perret, France.
